description: Replace an existing memory with a newer version. The old memory is kept as history (status: superseded) and retrieval returns the new one. Use when a saved fact becomes outdated and should be replaced rather than duplicated. Only active memories can be superseded; the new memory inherits type, tags, and aliases unless you pass replacements. An unknown id is reported back as a failure; nothing is written.

alias.description: D81: nickname the new memory defines (e.g. 香蕉计划). Omitted = inherit the old memory's alias.

aliases.description: Optional: alternate phrasings of this fact — synonyms, another way a question might be worded, equivalents in the user's other language (e.g. 节假日 for 'public holidays'). They are indexed with the memory so differently-worded questions still match. Always on. Send at most 4; extras and blanks are dropped silently, never an error.

id.description: ID of the memory being replaced.

tags.description: Optional tags for the new memory.

target.description: D81: what `alias` refers to (e.g. 支付系统重构项目). Omitted = inherit.

type.description: Category of the new memory. Defaults to the old memory's type.

name: memory_supersede
